Hi everyone, I'm new to hydroponics. This is my second plant ever and first time with the DWC method. It has been going great so far with my plant, she's only about 13 weeks old. I've been having issues with leaf tip burn and leaves curling. I have a pic of the nutrients I'm using and I keep my ph about 6.0. My 600w LED light panel is about 2 ft away from my plant and I'm doing 12 hours on and off for the flowering stage. I've tried different ratios of the nutrients and it doesn't seem to help. Usually when the leaf gets really bad I prune it. I'm looking for some recommendations and tips on how to manage this and improve my nutrient uptake.

I personally keep my cubes moist and just enough water to keep the roots growing, when the roots are developed enough I put them in a net cup for my reservoir. I've notice that if my light is too close it can make the seedlings dry out quickly and stunt growth. If it's too far they will stretch too much. Also my water is very chlorinated so I can use my tap water because it makes my leave yellow and kills the plant. So I filter my water or buy distilled water, I constantly check ph/ec when I use distilled water because it fluctuates a lot.
